title: DECSET 1005 — UTF-8 mouse mode (deprecated)
summary: CSI ? 1005 h enables UTF-8 mouse encoding: coordinates above 223 are encoded as UTF-8 sequences instead of the +32 byte form. CSI ? 1005 l disables it. Deprecated in favor of 1006 (SGR).

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1005 h Mouse tracking; UTF-8 coordinate encoding (deprecated).

gotchas: UTF-8 encoding avoids the 223 limit but has ambiguity with multibyte sequences.
Deprecated: use 1006 (SGR) instead, which uses decimal ASCII.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1005 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1005 h/l sequences.
